lights.rule: Area lights parented to the view camera. Each light's direction is the view direction (target to camera) turned azimuth_deg toward the camera's right and elevation_deg toward its up; it sits at distance_factor x R from the target and aims at it. R is the camera-to-target distance for perspective views and 1.5 x ortho_scale for orthographic views. Size is size_factor x R and power is energy x R^2 W, so the irradiance at the target is the same in every view.

world.rule: Camera rays see a vertical gradient (Texture Coordinate Window Y) from bottom_hex to top_hex, pre-compensated for the Khronos PBR Neutral toe so the PNG shows those hex values; every other ray sees a neutral grey Background at ambient_strength.

refinement_note: Seven native-picked renal cortical/column surfaces received conforming subdivision projected onto their original authored fields. All original vertices, all object transforms, detached 15x nephron and teaching cameras are retained. Visible finish awaits coordinated ordinary app review. Renal vein/IVC annular junction now uses the original split plane and identical shared outer/lumen field contours. Only these two meshes changed in this pass; visible finish awaits coordinated ordinary app review. Native diagnostic separates self-shadowed recessed polar facets from cut-sheet mesh ridges. This pass repairs only five picked cortical arches: same-field polar patch projection/local subdivision, and exposed region-sheet fairing with outer-envelope crease constraints. Vein v3 seam and all 38 magnified nephron meshes remain unchanged. Visible finish awaits ordinary UI review.
